thesis: This episode argues that the most significant opportunities in the modern economy lie with tech-enabled businesses that fundamentally transformed their sectors, such as NVIDIA, Walmart, and TSMC. The hosts suggest that these companies offer the clearest view of how the world works, while other major tech giants like Microsoft, Apple, and Google remain too large or recently covered to warrant immediate focus. The thesis also draws a parallel between past corporate collapses like Enron and FTX, using deep research to understand the structural risks in the market.

claims.quote: Everybody who believed that AI was going to be this complete step change in the way that we use computers, and decided that buying NVIDIA at a very high price was the way to endorse that belief. That ended up happening very quickly soon after.
